CODE
Art. 2.3.38.
 Legacies 
Legacies made by one of the spouses of all or part of the joint estate may not exceed his share in that estate. 
If the legacy relates to specific assets, the legatee may claim them in kind only if such assets, by the effect of the partition, are attributed to the testator's heirs; otherwise, the legatee is entitled, as a charge on the testator's estate, to the value of the assets bequeathed, subject to reduction in both cases if applicable.
